the number that surprised me building The Runway: 39. 🤍

39 real photographs, from her very first CMA red carpet in 2006 all the way to now — pulled together into 15 signature looks across all 12 eras.

not a single illustration or mockup. every image is a credited press or tour photo, from the gold fringe of Fearless to the cottagecore cardigans of folklore.

scroll her whole style evolution in one place: longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift performing the folklore set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, on a moss-covered cottage stage set.
A screenshot of Long Live's The Runway thread on longlivets.com, headed 'Twelve wardrobes, one story', showing a Showgirl-era look card and a colour-coded era timeline running down the right edge.
why: The Runway behind-the-data IG sibling, 09-16 beat, same story-unique campaign + scheduledAt as X. Number hook, first five words diverged from X. Carousel: media[0] cleared folklore Taylor photo (grid tile), media[1] thread-fashion-screen.png showing The Runway lens in actual use (timeline ridge + Showgirl look card + 'Twelve wardrobes, one story' — satisfies the 'cool feature only' rule). Facts counted from runway-looks.mjs: 39 images, 15 looks, 12 eras, 2006 CMA debut look, Fearless gold fringe ('Golden Fairy Tale'), folklore 'Cottagecore Cardigan' — all verified, none estimated. No 'tappable' claim (shopTags are static chips). Thread post = share-hook exempt.

critique.rationale: Runway behind-the-data: the surprise is 39 — real photographs from the 2006 CMAs to now, 15 looks, all 12 eras, zero illustrations. Counted from RUNWAY_LOOKS. Carousel puts the lens screenshot behind a folklore Taylor tile; no 'tappable' claim (shopTags are static chips).
